purpose: Prepare a safe staging layer for future formula dataset import without overwriting data/herbs/formulas.json.

scope.first_pass: Use existing 23 AcuTing formulas as the pilot batch.
scope.second_pass: Use data/herbs/formula_canon_shortlist.json 115 core records as the NCCAOM-oriented expansion target.
scope.excluded_for_now: No bulk 80k formula database import until source URL, license/access terms, field quality, and merge rules are reviewed.

review_policy.source_checked_rule: English-track formula facts require Bensky/Formulas & Strategies or Ting-approved school source review before source_checked. Chinese-track depth notes remain draft unless institution/textbook checked.
review_policy.clinical_use_rule: Modern clinical use tags and related conditions are search and study context only. They are not treatment claims, formula substitutions, or diagnosis replacements.

expansion_target.tier_rule: core records first; expanded records only after Ting approves scope.
expansion_target.content_rule: Do not fill imported clinical content directly into canonical records. Stage, validate, review, then merge.

merge_requirements: Run JSON parse check for data/**/*.json.
Update docs/REBUILD_HANDOFF.md before merging into canonical formula files.
